# Update-AvmAuthoring

## Synopsis

Update Avm.Authoring to the latest PowerShell Gallery version.

## Description

Queries the PowerShell Gallery for the latest published version. If the
running module is outdated, safely invokes Update-PSResource for the
CurrentUser scope. This command bypasses stale-version enforcement so
an outdated module can update itself.

Routed by the dispatcher: 'avm upgrade' (with 'avm update' retained as
a backwards-compatible alias).

## CLI commands

- `avm update`
- `avm upgrade`

## Syntax

```powershell
Update-AvmAuthoring [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Parameters

This cmdlet has no cmdlet-specific parameters.

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
avm upgrade
```

### EXAMPLE 2

```powershell
avm upgrade --what-if
```

## Outputs

- `System.Management.Automation.PSObject`
